restaurantName: Italian Afternoon Tea at La Terrazza Hotel Xenia
bio: Make the most of your afternoon and relax at La Terrazza in the heart of Kensington, the perfect setting to retire and unwind with Afternoon Tea after a busy morning exploring the nearby museums and galleries, or after shopping in Knightsbridge.  Afternoon Tea is served in La Terrazza, a contemporary Italian restaurant and conservatory, decked with hanging plants and colourful chairs, set against the custom made Fornasetti wallpaper.  Listen to live piano music, while you enjoy traditional savoury bites and a selection of delicious fruit scones and Italian cakes, with a glass of Prosecco and a choice of unlimited tea for £44 per person, or £49 per person, with a glass of Champagne.  Afternoon Tea is served from 2pm to 5.30pm Saturday and Sunday.
pageTitle: Italian Afternoon Tea at La Terrazza Hotel Xenia
